passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: Bill-text page of the same vote record; the operative section is a bare repeal of the Proposition 209 ban, and the long WHEREAS findings are recitals that do not govern.

rows.reasoning: Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5 (2019-2020), a single-subject constitutional amendment whose operative section is "That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed." — removing the ban on race-conscious public employment, education and contracting, which points away from "eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs" and away from "maintain current civil rights laws while promoting equal opportunity". But a bare repeal only permits race-conscious programs: it does not "mandate racial equity requirements in all institutions", and it evidences no part of "strengthen civil rights enforcement", leaving that rung's enforcement clause unsupported. The vote therefore establishes a direction without separating the rungs on that side.
